newsitem.title: UK: Travel group Thomas Cook revamps Internet site.
newsitem.headline: Travel group Thomas Cook revamps Internet site.

text.p: International travel and financial services group Thomas Cook said on Monday it had upgraded its Internet web site to offer extra information to holidaymakers.
The new site has a special feature -- the "Currency Converter" -- designed to tell users how much they will get for their currency.
Users will also be given access to advice on the country they are visiting, such as the type of travellers cheques they should take and details of any special offers and promotions.
Thomas Cook, which is majority owned by Germany's Westdeutsche Landesbank Girozentrale has had two million hits on its site since its launch in October 1995.
The new site has more colour and animation of images and Thomas Cook believes the modifications will increase the number of visits to the web site by over 50 percent.
The aim is to provide a site where customers will go to prepare for a trip abroad and also help them make the decision on their destination.
